about: Held-out routing set (backlog: routing accuracy measured only on the tuning set). Written 2026-11-19 after the Router prompt was tuned on cases.json, with new wording, a grocery and online-retail setting and more borderline messages. Labels were fixed before the first run. Never change the Router prompt to fit these cases: if a prompt change follows a held-out run, this set stops being held out and a new one is needed. Synthetic wording; nothing here comes from the eval answer keys.

cases.message: Category managers want average basket size per shopper visit, split by weekday and weekend.
We'll need to track how often shoppers buy private-label products instead of national brands.
A shopper visit is one receipt. Two receipts within ten minutes at the same store still count as two visits.
When we say 'active shopper', is that 90 days or 12 months?
Re the open question on weighted items: price them per kilo, and count each weighed bag as one unit.
The definition of order value is wrong: shipping fees should not be in it.
The delivery-time requirement is more important than the coupon one. Mark it as high priority.
Who asked for the abandoned cart metric, and what was it for?
Operations also wants on-time delivery rate by carrier.
Points earned and points redeemed must never be netted against each other in reports.
Build a first draft of the model now, please.
Split dim_customer into a customer dimension and a separate address dimension.
What is the grain of fact_order_items?
Are there orders in the source with no shipment record at all?
Walk me through why the proposal drops the payment dimension.
Make the order date and the ship date both role-play the calendar dimension.
Run a check that every order item has a product in the source.
Can discount_amount be summed across orders, or only within one?
Add a degenerate transaction number to the points fact.
Throw away the proposal and start the design again from the current registers.
Marketing now needs revenue by referral source, so add referral source to the order fact.
From now on a late delivery is anything after the promised date, not the requested date. Update the delivery fact to use it.
One more requirement, substitutions per order by category, and then go ahead and design the model.
Finance also needs refunds by payment method. Put that in the proposal before I review it.
Expired points now count as redeemed for liability reporting; change the points fact so it can show that.
We need to see orders by warehouse too. Add a warehouse dimension.
Add the coupon code to fact_orders.
Customer service wants to report on complaints by product. That's a new requirement.
Does the 'net order value' column on the fact mean before or after returns?
Which table and column does net order value come from in the source?
Can the data actually support basket size by shopper, given that most receipts have no loyalty card?
